articles.company_name: Array Digital Infrastructure Inc. Common Shares
articles.summary: As previously announced, Array will hold a teleconference on November 6, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. CT. Listen to the call live via the Events Presentations page of investors.arrayinc.com. Array Digital Infrastructure, Inc. (NYSE:AD) reported third quarter operating results. "As Array marks its first year as a tower company, we continue to make meaningful progress against our 2026 strategic priorities," said Anthony Carlson, President and CEO. "Our team remains intensely focused on maximizing the value of our tower portfolio by driving tenant growth and enhancing operational efficiency. These efforts are strengthening the earnings power of our assets and positioning the company for long-term value creation." Highlights* Optimizing tower operations Site rental revenues grew 14% year over year Delivered consecutive quarter-over-quarter colocation growth Continuing to close pending sales of wireless spectrum Received regulatory approval for remaining pending transactions in October,
articles.title: Array reports third quarter 2026 results
